checks: Anonymous API refuses access; protected library returns to real login; successful login preserves /library; real empty SQLite renders empty state.

Real disabled storage remains listed without a thumbnail request; trash is excluded from cards and count; processing/failed assets retain decoded real thumbnails; active and previous failed jobs display independently.
Actual missing thumbnail file renders explicit failure without original fallback; mobile menu Escape restores trigger focus.

Real mixed assets and timestamp ties paginate 40 → 80 → 85 in ascending ID order within timestamp ties; lost real next-page response retains cards; keyboard retry uses same cursor; held response rejects duplicate submission.
Access explanation opens by pointer and keyboard, fits the viewport, and Escape closes it and restores its trigger.
Decoded preview preserves its natural aspect ratio without cropping or a large colored background.
Holding the real detail response exposes loading; losing a real refresh response exposes an error and hides stale content; refresh retries the real endpoint.
Version tabs switch by keyboard arrows and wrap past the disabled unsaved watermark tab.
Detail opens through actual keyboard card activation; Escape restores the card focus and library scroll position.
Desktop keyboard opens More on the visible Refresh item; arrow navigation cycles only visible actions and Escape restores More.
Real Clipboard write succeeds after clicking Copy URL; no clipboard read permission is requested.

Direct detail URL decodes real saved bytes; viewing compressed does not change default copy selection; actual Chromium Permissions-Policy clipboard denial exposes focused selected text; download preserves Chinese filename and real bytes.
Changing the real default setting is reflected when copy reopens while the compressed preview stays selected; default URLs omit type; unsaved explicit watermark returns 404.
Missing thumbnail download HEAD returns 404 and displays the explicit download error without requesting another version.
After a real thumbnail file read failure, restoring the fixture file and manually refreshing decodes that same thumbnail without an original fallback.
Mobile details keep Copy and More in the fixed footer; download, refresh and trash use the real menu; Escape and cancelling trash return focus to the persistent More button.
Real failed/private, pending and disabled-storage records show their states across five widths and both themes; missing watermark is disabled; short viewport copy action opens the real copy dialog.
Pre-write GET race (normal): confirmed trash survives old-read completion, removes detail/card, and sends exactly one real POST.
Pre-write GET race (lost-write): confirmed trash survives old-read completion, removes detail/card, and sends exactly one real POST after explicit unknown-result reconciliation.
Pre-write GET race (late-success): confirmed trash survives old-read completion, removes detail/card, and sends exactly one real POST.

Trash cancellation and Escape restore trigger focus without writes; held real POST disables duplicate submission; successful trash removes detail/card and every saved version rejects owner and anonymous reads.
A blocked real thumbnail request shows a readable failure; refreshing the trash list retries the unchanged preview URL and displays the decoded image.
Opening a trash record and using its top return control restores focus to the original record.
Access explanation opens by pointer and keyboard, fits the viewport, and Escape closes it and restores its trigger.
Decoded preview preserves its natural aspect ratio without cropping or a large colored background.

Real trash records render decoded thumbnails and detail previews through the owner-only route; anonymous preview is rejected and no /i content is requested; restore cancellation restores focus; restoration removes the record and the identical anonymous URL returns identical original bytes.
Disabled storage permits record trash/restore; success explicitly says the storage remains disabled; real content remains unreadable and storage is not enabled.
A real concurrent deleting transition returns HTTP 409 and triggers a current-record read; the trashed record remains and reopening disables restore.
Losing the real successful restore response and its real reconciliation read preserves an unknown-result state; manual reconciliation discovers the committed result without repeating the write.

Leaving a held real restore through browser Back and opening another record prevents the late response from closing or changing the new record; reopening the original record resumes a real read and shows its already-restored state without another write.
A record really deleted after confirmation opens produces HTTP 404 and a definite missing-record result, not an indefinitely unknown mutation.
A real expired owner session during restore/reconciliation redirects to login with the exact trash record return target; signing in returns to that record.
A real zero-record query renders empty; losing the real refresh response renders an error rather than an empty state; retry reads the real endpoint.
The 390×400 shortened viewport keeps the real record restore action reachable; this is not a physical keyboard or safe-area device test.
Initial reload transport failure is explicit and retries real endpoint; expired real SQLite session makes the next library API read return to login.
